MathJax 3.2.2
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjax/-/mathjax-3.2.2.tgz
Upstream: https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax

This subset contains tex-chtml.js, TeX extensions, the assistive MathML
extension and CommonHTML fonts. It renders equations in the delivered
documentation without an internet connection. The upstream Apache 2.0
license is reproduced in LICENSE.
